registrationNotes: Unchanged native complete-body cells. Uniform measured scale per sheet, projected pelvis/floor pivot, baselineLift0. Closed dominant hand or supporting-palm grip points manually calibrated against native sheets. Hold-sheet first row is explicitly rejected, never an active clip. Weapons and carried objects remain separate whole native items; no body-part transforms. Per-weapon native grip, angle, behind/front placement and complete-cel palm occlusion registered in attachmentSchema1. Firearm idle uses full authored fire_ready cel; original base cels and PNG bytes preserved.
